release_notes: ADMIN THEME: applied the modern PlanetHosts design globally across ALL admin pages (matching the redesigned account list). themes/admin/default/layout.css upgraded: gradient card backgrounds (linear-gradient #0b1f39->#08192d), cleaner tables (rounded #102847 header row, #183655 borders, hover highlight #0c2340), modern buttons (#1683ff), form controls/selects (#0b2543 bg), badges, alerts, stat cards, progress bars, sidebar gradient (#071a30->#061426) with active nav gradient (#147ff0->#0c65c8), radial main background, and updated theme.json palette (primary #1683ff, bg #04101f, text #e8f1ff, muted #8ea8c5, border #17385b). Verified dashboard, packages, dns, billing products all render with the new CSS.
